name: Detailer Shield Insurance
description: Specialized business insurance for mobile auto detailing operators — general liability, equipment, tools, vehicle, and pollution coverage tailored to mobile detailing operations.

mainEntity.name: What does mobile detailing insurance cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mobile detailing insurance typically covers general liability (third-party bodily injury and property damage), inland marine coverage for tools and equipment, commercial auto for your mobile unit, and pollution liability for chemical and wastewater runoff. Policies are tailored to the services you offer, such as paint correction, ceramic coating, and pressure washing.

mainEntity.name: How much does insurance cost for a mobile detailing business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on your services, number of employees, vehicle use, equipment value, annual revenue, and the states you operate in. A licensed agent can quote tailored coverage in about 15 minutes. Contact Contractors Choice Agency for a personalized quote.

mainEntity.name: Does general liability cover damage to a customer's vehicle while I'm detailing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: General liability alone usually does not cover damage to a customer's vehicle in your care. That is typically covered under a garage-keepers or inland marine endorsement. We recommend bundling coverages so the customer's vehicle is protected while you work on it.
